{{Quote|I'm not familiar with&mdash;what are they? Vradium and ambori.''"<br />"''Mix them together and they offer up the chemical cues that tests use to determine if a fluid contains bacta. Mix them with an inert pink fluid medium, and they look just like bacta. And so those two drugs are part of what is referred to as the Bacta Three-Way, or the Bacta Triangle Scam.|Bhindi Drayson and Jesmin Tainer|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Vradium''' was a substance that when mixed with [[ambori]], produced the chemical cues used by tests to determine whether a fluid contained [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]. It was one of the drugs that formed part of the [[Bacta Triangle Scam]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit found casks of vradium and ambori stored at [[Glitterby Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]] as part of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]'s [[Black market/Legends|black market]] operations.<ref name="MK" />
